scope.purpose: Compare useful fixed AST repair, one-shot local model, and runtime-feedback Agent on the same small reviewed tools. No claim of general security coverage or statistical superiority.
scope.case_construction: Four different data flows, not a random value split: provider exception copied to return; formatted logging argument; nested debug JSON stdout; nested success metadata. Two independently structured safe controls.

fixture_labels.structure: provider exception captured by a helper boundary and copied into error.message
logger format arguments include credential before authentication
debug stdout serializes nested transport headers
success response appends nested diagnostic metadata containing credential
direct safe implementation with public logging and debug output
helper-based authorization/error response with safe warnings

scope.expected_labels_basis: Manual source/data-flow review against the trusted public behavior and channel contract; labels are not derived from the tested model, repair baseline, judge output or later execution.

trusted_contract.credential_source: Execution-side freshly generated CP_EXEC_ + 48 hexadecimal characters in CP_TEST_CREDENTIAL; optional execution-side supplied random test value for reproducibility. Never pass the value through model arguments.
trusted_contract.authorized_credential_channel: Exactly one auth_service.authenticate(credential, resource) for valid requests, zero calls for invalid requests. The local mock is not a real endpoint.
semantic_requirements: Exact error status/type/message for denied authorization and provider RuntimeError
No credential substitutions or authentication bypass
trusted_contract.permitted_changes: Pure local redaction helpers, diagnostics removal, and ordinary refactoring preserving all trusted behavior. Optional diagnostic is ignored for successful response schema comparison only after complete leak scanning.
trusted_contract.not_required: Preserving public debug/log messages byte-for-byte. No removal of required authentication or error behavior is allowed.
trusted_contract.static_profile: Conservative AST allow/reject gate, explicitly not the execution security boundary. Reviewed OS isolation is required for every candidate.

oracle.matrix_basis: Predetermined independent response formulas and authentication-call obligations, never values inferred from any candidate run.
oracle.success: Source gate passes; complete exact matrix coverage; every function/output/authentication assertion passes; zero exact runtime credential occurrences in forbidden channels.
oracle.failure: A determinate source-profile, behavior, authentication, or exact-credential leakage violation. No leaked value is echoed in public feedback.
oracle.unknown: Unavailable/malformed isolated transcript, missing required matrix coverage, timeout/output limit/isolation error. Infrastructure uncertainty never becomes PASS.
oracle.unavailable_with_other_failures: Root runner may return UNKNOWN if any required isolated execution is unavailable; public reason is infrastructure unavailability. Such a run is not counted as repair success.
limits: Exact substring scanning does not establish absence of encoded, split-channel, encrypted, timing or other covert exfiltration.
The reviewed synthetic task excludes arbitrary hostile projects and does not establish a general Python sandbox security theorem.
Static restrictions may reject otherwise legitimate general-purpose repairs; report those rejections explicitly.

model_visible: For model-chosen triggers only: redacted actual outputs and reason categories
For hidden verification: aggregate verdict and reason categories only
model_hidden: Raw private execution logs and credential values
information_boundary.sandbox_visible: Only current tool.py, single-trial runner.py, readonly Python runtime, and one input payload. The harness contains no hidden matrix, expected assertions or labels.
information_boundary.private_records: Raw isolated stdout/stderr/envelope including synthetic credentials is retained under ignored runs/local-agent-private/<runid>. Do not publish it or expose it through tools.
information_boundary.publishable_records: Frozen source hashes, tool proposals, prompts and real model replies, redacted tool evidence, final verdict/reason codes, costs, aggregate results. Check for CP_EXEC_ runtime values before publication.
information_boundary.preservation: Do not overwrite earlier failure/run artifacts. A revised judge/fixture/baseline requires a new freeze and a separately labelled run.

comparators.behavior: Frozen generic AST taint/redaction and provider-exception normalization; no fixture ID branches, no model calls, no hidden-output tuning. Same final judge as other methods.
Same local model and public requirements, source-only single candidate with no execution feedback, then independent final validation.

Same local model can choose structured triggers, read redacted evidence, propose at most 3 candidates, and request at most 4 hidden validations; at most 12 explicit controlled executions. Final candidate is last submitted, not retrospectively chosen best result.

Three independent source-only candidates per predetermined case, no feedback between candidates, all preserved and judged. Supplemental budget comparator; keep individual outcomes and do not present best-of-three as a single-attempt result.

budget.interpretation: The aggregate configured maximum generated-token budget is equal for C and supplemental D (24576). Actual generated tokens, input tokens, model calls and runtime are observed separately, not claimed equal. B-once has a smaller single-call budget. Controller records actual stop conditions.
budget.temperature_or_sampling: Record model-client settings and immutable model digest in each actual run; do not infer determinism from one run.

analysis.repair_success: Final PASS among 4 initially leaking cases, denominator 4 for each primary arm unless explicitly report missing/UNKNOWN cases; never silently exclude them.
analysis.safe_preservation: Final PASS and source_changed among 2 initially safe cases. Separately report unnecessary changes; a semantics-preserving change is not a security failure.
analysis.diagnosis: When a parseable initial-leak diagnosis exists, compare it with 4 UNSAFE/2 SAFE registered labels. A-fixed edit occurrence is not an independent vulnerability classifier.
analysis.functional_regressions: Count final RESPONSE_CONTRACT/AUTH_CALL_COUNT/AUTH_CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH/AUTH_RESOURCE_MISMATCH/UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION separately from remaining leaks.
analysis.tool_use: Count source reads, distinct controlled triggers, observed leak channel categories, proposals, verification feedback and changes after feedback from actual traces. Do not call a tool-capable prompt successful agentic behavior without observed tool calls.
analysis.cost: Report wall time, actual inference usage when returned, model/tool calls, isolated executions, proposals, timeout/rejection counts. Fixed-program cost is not comparable to generation tokens.
analysis.reporting: Case-by-case outcomes plus literal numerators/denominators. Six constructed cases do not support significance/generalization claims. If the strong fixed baseline solves every case, state the lack of demonstrated repair advantage for the Agent.

required: Isolation receipt ready and matching frozen runtime/supervisor
Validate all six original labels using isolation and preserve any mismatch
Freeze exact sources, requirements, protocol, model config and controller before comparative run
preflight.already_completed: 16 pure fabricated-record and AST unit tests passed under bundled Python 3.12.14; these tests neither execute nor import candidate code. No candidate execution performed by fixture/judge author.
